name: bootcamp-tracker
description: Manage group classes from chat: set up your group, class packs, memberships, attendance, sessions and renewals for trainers, studios and clubs.

interface.longDescription:
Bootcamp Tracker is management software for trainers, studios and clubs that run group classes — bootcamps, outdoor training, martial arts, dance, functional training.

Set up your group right here in the chat: paste your student list (or share a photo of it) with the classes each has left, tell ChatGPT your class packs and memberships and your weekly timetable ("every Monday and Wednesday at 19:30 until Christmas"), and get the link with a ready-to-send message for your students.

Then manage it by chat: who's coming today, who needs to renew, how many classes a student has left or when their membership ends, and how much you took in this month.

With your confirmation, ChatGPT can take attendance, schedule, move or cancel sessions, add classes or start a membership (1, 3, 6, 12 months; unlimited or N classes a month), record payments, edit or remove students, remind them to renew, accept students who ask to join, and confirm or decline renewals your students request from their phone.

Every change can be undone for 24 hours. Students' emails and phone numbers are never shared. You approve access on a consent screen and can revoke it at any time in Security > Connected apps.

Limitations: you sign in with a Bootcamp Tracker account; if you don't have one yet, it is created when you connect. It only accesses the groups you run or co-train. Payments are bookkeeping only: nothing is charged.
capabilities: Set up a group: students, class packs and weekly sessions
See your schedule, who needs to renew and income
Add classes, start memberships and record payments
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my training group.
Who in my groups needs to renew their class pack?
Mark everyone on today's session list as present.

positive.prompt: What's on my schedule this week?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists today's 07:00 and tomorrow's 19:00 Sunrise Bootcamp sessions with 3 students on each list.

positive.description: Students who should renew their class pack
positive.prompt: Who in Sunrise Bootcamp needs to renew?
positive.expected_behavior: Names Marta (0 classes left) and Luis (2 classes left); Ana (10) is not listed.
Lists Marta's pending request for the 10-class pack ($120), with her note "Paid by bank transfer".

positive.description: Confirm a renewal once the trainer was paid
positive.prompt: Confirm Marta's renewal, her transfer arrived.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm, then confirms the request: Marta goes from 0 to 10 classes and a $120 payment is recorded. Returns a change id that can be undone.

positive.prompt: Mark Ana and Luis as present at today's session.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm the names, then closes today's 07:00 session: Ana goes from 10 to 9 classes and Luis from 2 to 1. Returns a change id that can be undone.

positive.description: Reschedule a session and set its capacity
positive.prompt: Move tomorrow's session to 20:00 and cap it at 12 people.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm, then changes tomorrow's session from 19:00 to 20:00 with capacity 12; other fields are unchanged.

positive.prompt: Undo the last change you made.
positive.expected_behavior: Identifies the reschedule, asks to confirm, then restores tomorrow's session to 19:00 with its previous capacity.

positive.prompt: Start the Quarterly unlimited membership for Luis.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm, then starts Luis's 3-month Quarterly unlimited membership from today (his class balance is unchanged). Returns a change id that can be undone.

positive.description: Set up a new group with students
positive.prompt: Create a group called Evening Runners (Los Angeles, USD) and add Sara with 5 classes and Tom with 8.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm, then creates the Evening Runners group (America/Los_Angeles, USD) and adds Sara (5 classes) and Tom (8 classes). Returns change ids that can be undone.

positive.prompt: In Sunrise Bootcamp, schedule Park HIIT every Tuesday and Thursday at 18:00 for the next 3 weeks.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the dates back and asks to confirm, then creates 6 Park HIIT sessions at 18:00 (Tuesdays and Thursdays over the next 3 weeks). Returns a change id that undoes all of them.

positive.prompt: How much did I take in this month in Sunrise Bootcamp?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports $120.00 recorded this month, from Ana (10-class pack). Mentions that payments are recorded by the trainer, not charged.

positive.prompt: Raise the 10-class pack in Sunrise Bootcamp to $130.
positive.expected_behavior: Asks to confirm, then changes the 10-class pack price from $120 to $130; students who already have it are unaffected. Returns a change id that can be undone.

positive.description: Invite students with a ready-to-send message
positive.prompt: Give me the link for my students to join Sunrise Bootcamp, with a message in English I can send on WhatsApp.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the group's join link (https://bootcamptracker.app/g/...) and a ready-to-send English message containing it, plus a WhatsApp share link.

negative.description: General fitness advice is not a Bootcamp Tracker task; the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Give me a 20-minute HIIT warm-up for beginners.

negative.description: Charging or transferring money is not supported (payments are bookkeeping only); ChatGPT should explain that and not record anything.
negative.prompt: Charge Ana 50 euros on her card.

negative.description: Data outside the trainer's own groups is not accessible; ChatGPT should say it can only see the trainer's groups.
negative.prompt: Show me the students of the CrossFit club across town.

review.commerce_description: Bootcamp Tracker does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT. record_payment only writes a bookkeeping entry for a payment the trainer already received.

publication.release_notes: Set up and run a group from chat. New tools: create_group, update_group (including switching renewals on), import_students (a pasted list or a photo of one), create_package, update_package, delete_package, create_series (recurring sessions), get_join_link (with a ready-to-send message), join_requests and answer_join_request, cancel_session, update_student, remove_student, remind_to_renew and income_summary. New accounts created while connecting become trainer accounts (name and terms on the consent screen). Every change can still be undone for 24 hours. Updated description.

es-ES.subtitle: Gestiona tus clases de fitness
es-ES.description:
Bootcamp Tracker es un software de gestión para entrenadores, estudios y clubes que dan clases en grupo: bootcamps, entrenamiento al aire libre, artes marciales, baile, entrenamiento funcional.

Prepara tu grupo aquí mismo, en el chat: pega tu lista de alumnos (o sube una foto) con las clases que le quedan a cada uno, dile a ChatGPT tus bonos y cuotas y tu horario semanal («lunes y miércoles a las 19:30 hasta Navidad») y obtén el enlace con un mensaje listo para enviar a tus alumnos.

Después, gestiónalo desde el chat: quién viene hoy, quién tiene que renovar, cuántas clases le quedan a un alumno o cuándo termina su cuota, y cuánto has cobrado este mes.

Con tu confirmación, ChatGPT puede pasar lista, programar, mover o cancelar sesiones, añadir clases o activar una cuota (1, 3, 6 o 12 meses; ilimitada o N clases al mes), registrar pagos, editar o eliminar alumnos, recordarles que renueven, aceptar a quien pida unirse y confirmar o rechazar las renovaciones que tus alumnos piden desde el móvil.

Cualquier cambio se puede deshacer durante 24 horas. Nunca se comparten el email ni el teléfono de los alumnos. Autorizas el acceso en una pantalla de consentimiento y puedes revocarlo cuando quieras en Seguridad > Apps conectadas.

Limitaciones: inicias sesión con una cuenta de Bootcamp Tracker; si aún no tienes, se crea al conectar. Solo accede a los grupos que diriges o compartes. Los pagos son solo para llevar las cuentas: no se cobra nada.
